summary: An automated AI morning news explainer video generated by Grok Bot powered by Claude Opus 5.5, which selected news topics, drafted copy, generated voiceover, and wrote code to render paper-cut style animations.
summaryEn: Opus 5.5 Agent Generates Daily AI News Explainer with Paper-Cut Motion Graphics

post.originalText:
看完 Grok Bot 做的这条视频，我直接瘫在椅子上了 😱
现在默认Opus 5.5 干活，这条 AI 早报从选题、文案、配音到动画，全是它一个人做的，我只说了一句“每天给我做一期 AI 早报视频”，它就自己找新闻、写稿、配音，再写代码一帧帧画出这套剪纸动画 👇
审美各个方面这块断档领先 https://t.co/aaFBoBkcAa
